name: Sacred DSOAL
author: kirides
description: Positional 3D sound and EAX-style reverb for Sacred Gold through DSOAL and OpenAL Soft (official kcat/dsoal release), with a Speakers or Headphones (HRTF) setting. See docs/Dsoal.md.

mods.author: DSOAL and OpenAL Soft contributors
mods.name: sacred-dsoal (base)
mods.description: Switches on the 3D audio Sacred was built for: positional 3D sound and EAX-style reverb. DSOAL (dsound.dll) presents a hardware DirectSound3D/EAX device to the game and OpenAL Soft (dsoal-aldrv.dll) mixes on any sound card. Installs only the two DLLs; pick Speakers or Headphones for the output setting. Needs the Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 Redistributable (x86). After installing, choose "3D, alle Effekte" in the sound options and restart the game.

mods.author: DSOAL and OpenAL Soft contributors
mods.name: DSOAL Headphones (alsoft.ini, HRTF)
mods.description: Audio setting for headphones: stereo output with HRTF spatialisation (the official DSOAL+HRTF alsoft.ini: channels=stereo, stereo-mode=headphones, stereo-encoding=hrtf). Installs only an alsoft.ini. Installs the base plugin first; replaces the Speakers setting.

mods.author: DSOAL and OpenAL Soft contributors
mods.name: DSOAL Speakers (alsoft.ini)
mods.description: Audio setting for speakers: stereo output is played as speakers with plain panning and no HRTF; the speaker layout comes from the Windows sound settings. Installs only an alsoft.ini. Installs the base plugin first; replaces the Headphones setting.
